data.name: Florent
data.gender_notes: Florent is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word flos, meaning 'flower', and the adjective florentis, meaning 'flourishing' or 'abundant'. In Christianity, St. Florentius is believed to have lived during the 5th century and is the patron saint of flowers and the city of Bari in Italy. The name Florent carries the meaning “Golden flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Florent usually hope their child will grow to embody golden flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes growth, beauty, and the passage of time.
data.etymology: Florent belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Florent total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
